title: metadata-protocol / spec: a draft carries no per-field provenance (which surface changed which key, and when), so Studio cannot mark a copilot's draft change with the ruled 草稿 chip and 来源 line
body:
Filing gate ③: a ruled design's producer half, with the gap measured. Filed by `repo:cloud#2` (seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#24145, session `session_01Cbdek8SKSHxddGqTPZXdqX`) from the objectstack-ai/objectui#12725 phase-5 dev report (objectui PR #12952). Platform first, per the maintainer's standing 口径 「平台相关的功能，应该尽量先改平台。」. ⛔ Not a claim.

Earlier blocker, read closed: #24324 (ruled A on `6250704607`, the hold lifted; director pointer `6250719920`).

Held on the maintainer's word (director comment `6249880263`); the release and the resume point are in comment `6250059826`.

## The ruled pull

objectstack-ai/objectui#12725 Target item 3. The maintainer's rulings are on the card: 「属性好需要考虑选中每个元素的时候也要显示」, then 「按「右栏二选一」定稿」 on the StudioRailProps artboard. A field or view setting the copilot changed carries a 草稿 chip and a 来源 line, for example 「由 AI 副驾在 2 分钟前作为草稿加入」.

## Measured: no declared key carries it (framework pin `be076dad28a0`)

- **`ListDraftsResponseSchema`** (`packages/spec/src/api/protocol.zod.ts`): each row is `type`, `name`, `member`, `label`, `packageId`, `updatedAt` and `updatedBy`. That is per item, not per changed key.
- **`SysMetadataRepository.listDrafts`** (`packages/metadata-protocol/src/sys-metadata-repository.ts`) sets `updatedBy` from `row.updated_by ?? row.created_by`. That is the acting user, which is the same person for a copilot edit and a hand edit in Studio.
- **`sys_metadata.source`** (`filesystem | database | api | migration`) is the storage origin, not the authoring surface, and it is not projected.
- **The copilot's own envelope** (cloud `service-ai-studio`, `applyDraft`) carries `changedKeys`, but only inside the conversation. Studio's properties never see it.

So Studio cannot tell a copilot change from a Studio change, or which keys changed. objectui#12725's phase 5 drew nothing for item 3.

## Wanted (the lane picks the shape; one sketch)

- A draft declares per-key provenance. For example, a `changes` list on each `_drafts` row (or on the draft read of `GET /meta/:type/:name`), with one entry per changed key path (`fields.renewal_count`, `kanban.columns`):
  - `by`: the authoring surface, `copilot | studio | api`;
  - `actor`;
  - `at`.
- It is kept until publish or discard, and declared in `ListDraftsResponseSchema`.
- **The writers:**
  - the framework's save door stamps `studio` / `api`;
  - cloud's copilot tools stamp `copilot` through the same door, as a cloud follow-up once the pin carries this.
- **The reader:** Studio's properties draw the 草稿 chip and the 来源 line, as an objectui follow-up.
- Declared is enforced: no key without its writer and its reader.

Dedupe: semantic search of this repository for `per-field draft provenance`, `listDrafts`, `who drafted`, `source line`. The nearest are #24253 (the opt-in backfill on publish) and #23715 (a strict draft read), and neither covers this.
